SNCF Connect, the all-in-one app for all your journeys

Travel with SNCF Connect, the leading app for rail and sustainable mobility, supporting more than 15 million users with their journeys across France and Europe.

With you every step of the way
A true everyday travel companion, SNCF Connect lets you plan, book and manage all your journeys in just a few clicks:

- Plan ahead and organise your trips by finding the right journey at the best price
- Buy and access your tickets, cards/subscriptions and travel passes in one place
- Exchange and cancel your bookings easily

Everyday journeys and special occasions alike
Find all your train journeys in France and Europe in one place, along with your public transport journeys (metro, bus, tram) and even your carpooling and taxi/private hire trips. Travel with peace of mind thanks to car hire services, Allianz Travel, Junior & Cie, onboard catering, Mes Bagages and ALL Accor hotels.

Personalised and proactive information
SNCF Connect is more than just a ticket booking app. It is also a tool that keeps you informed and sends real-time alerts to make your journeys easier.

Features designed to help you every day

Plan a journey:
- Search for the best route to your destination
- Book your train tickets in France (TER, TGV INOUI, OUIGO Grande Vitesse and Train Classique, INTERCITÉS), to destinations in Europe (TGV Lyria, Eurostar (formerly Thalys), DB SNCF Voyageurs), in Germany (Deutsche Bahn) and in Switzerland (SBB CFF FFS)
- Buy public transport tickets in Paris and the Île-de-France region (IDFM network) and in 62 cities across France (metro, bus, tram, RER, Transilien SNCF, RATP)
- Book coach services (FlixBus, BlaBlaCar Bus), BlaBlaCar carpooling and Uber taxi/private hire services
- Set booking alerts, low price alerts and train full alerts to find the train ticket that suits you
- Place an option on a ticket to lock in the price for a set period

Book travel tickets and subscriptions:
- Buy all your train tickets, cartes Avantage and Carte Liberté, SNCF subscriptions including regional TER subscriptions, as well as Deutsche Bahn (Germany) and SBB tickets (Switzerland)
- In Île-de-France, top up your Navigo pass directly on your phone
- Buy and validate digital tickets and travel passes for the RATP & SNCF network in Île-de-France (Metro-Train-RER Tickets, Bus-Tram Tickets, Paris Region <> Airports tickets, Navigo pass)
